title: Normalize and deduplicate T-LOCALHARNESSZ0* task records to restore task_records governance
goal: Remove the four duplicate open .agents/tasks/T-LOCALHARNESSZ0*.json files introduced by 06e38eab029ebbf4ba83d784f636b72234e542be and normalize their four .agents/tasks/done/T-LOCALHARNESSZ0*.json records to strict susi.task_record/v1 provenance so cargo test --offline --locked --test task_records passes 3/3 without expanding task_record_schema_debt.json.

reuse.justification: Normalized the four closed T-LOCALHARNESSZ0* records directly to the existing susi.task_record/v1 schema validated by tests/task_records.rs (using susi_paths::hex::encode) without modifying test logic or expanding task_record_schema_debt.json.
